releases.name: ebutuoy 2026-11-09
releases.body: Added a TV mode to the launch screen. A cream colored TV cabinet has a knob that speeds up when you spin it fast, channel buttons, and a box to type a channel number. Each number from 1 to 1,000,000 plays that channel's videos newest first in thirty second samples.

jobs.description: Discovery app that plays short samples of rarely seen videos from small channels.

releases.name: ebutuoy backend 2026-11-09
releases.body: Added numbered TV channels from 1 to 1,000,000. Each number is tied to one channel the first time it is tuned. New routes serve a channel, its videos, and stats.

jobs.description: Backend service for ebutuoy that finds little seen videos and remembers what was served.

releases.name: Road Layers 2026-11-08
releases.body: Recordings now save inside the app in a library with crash recovery. Added stop motion capture, a Map tab with coverage routes, and a Road tab that tracks lane lines and bends. The composite step lets you pick which roadside things to cut out.

jobs.description: Road Layers stacks cars from several drive clips onto one road in the browser.

releases.name: Badge Tool 2026-11-08
releases.body: Added a back side builder for badges with an NFC spot, a QR code, text boxes, seals, and a security look. The Back view can be opened at any time.

jobs.description: A badge designer with templates, people, and a paper mockup reader.

releases.name: FLIPCOUNT 2026-11-08
releases.body: Created FLIPCOUNT with seven tabs for counting and number toys. Added a languages tab with spoken words, ancient numerals, and world digit scripts.

jobs.description: Counting toys with a flip dot display, an abacus, and number scripts from many languages.

releases.name: Pajamastan Space Administration 2026-11-08
releases.body: Created the page with a globe showing live solar activity and satellite risk. Added a solar burst simulator and live satellite positions with hazard coloring and a backup orbit feed.
